response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior full-stack engineer with strong web, testing, and open-source credentials, but falls well short of the core minimum qualifications: his C++ experience amounts to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a thesis project, versus the required 8 years. His career centers on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang product work rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and he shows no formal technical-leadership or mentoring role at the scale the position demands. The systems-level DLang work at Sociomantic and platform work on GISCollective are relevant but insufficient to bridge the gap for a cloud compute platform tech lead.
strengths: High-throughput, low-latency systems experience at Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and active knowledge-sharing via workshops and talks
Broad, self-directed engineering range including Kubernetes deployments, DevOps tooling, and open-source platform ownership
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~7 months professionally)
No formal technical-leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or leading cross-team platform strategy
Career focus is web/product full-stack development, not cloud compute infrastructure or hardware/storage architecture
